title: The All-in-One Video Gallery – Video Player & Galleries for YouTube, Vimeo & Self-Hosted Videos plugin for WordPress…
description: The All-in-One Video Gallery plugin for WordPress, up to and including version 4.9.7, contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability via the 'more_link' parameter. This flaw allows authenticated users with contributor-level access or higher to inject malicious scripts that execute when other users view the affected pages.
